units.source_text: “先不管她答复不答复，我也想尽量谈谈试试看。”

en.t: Whether she answers or not, I still want to try talking with her as much as I can.

units.source_text: 我说完，在澡堂里泡不到两分钟，就赶忙揩拭身体。

en.t: After saying that, I had been soaking in the bathhouse for less than two minutes when I hurriedly wiped myself dry.
